title: Hearty Harmonious Moroccan Vegetable Tagine
description: This cultured and springy Moroccan dish features red curry paste and fermented ingredients, making it a great vegetarian option for a energizing meal. It combines the flavors of Morocco with the health benefits of fermented food.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the chickpeas, vegetable broth, fermented vegetables, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
